old_failure_proof.kind: preserved actual live runner failure; not post-hoc rescored

focused_new_behavior.command: python -m pytest tests/core/test_psem_r2_live_runner.py -q -k 'eof_flush or eof_tail' (inside final capsule)
focused_new_behavior.pcm_assertion: Each residual's original real samples were byte-for-byte equal to the prefix received by the VAD engine and every completion sample was zero.
focused_new_behavior.voiced_tail_provider_assertion: A 171-sample voiced tail with VAD initially closed formed and retired one normal provider segment (submitted=1, terminal=1, parents=1), with fed real=171, flush pad=341, buffered=0 and dropped=0.
focused_new_behavior.native_evidence_assertion: The voiced-tail run disabled intercept evidence and boundary hypotheses; receipts and parent evidence were both empty. Padding therefore created no native receipt, coverage evidence, or ownership transition.

budget_regression.contract: The operationally unsuccessful meeting remains unclean and keeps the full reservation; assertions that incidentally depended on the removed silent-tail drop were deleted.

source_frontier_analysis.real_eof_truth: fed_source_samples is the real EOF frontier. flush_pad_source_samples and synthetic_hangover_samples are separate non-real channels.
source_frontier_analysis.processed_frame_coordinate: The preexisting fixed-frame C5/VAD path advances its processing cursor and capture spans by complete frames, including final-frame padding and later synthetic hangover. Thus a partial final frame has a processed-frame endpoint beyond the real EOF endpoint.
source_frontier_analysis.admission_effect: This processing cursor is not converted into U13 native observation evidence. U13 admission coverage comes from separately received owner evidence with source ranges and generation/reference validity. The new voiced-tail proof produced a provider parent but no receipts or evidence, so it could not fabricate covered ownership or a partition.
source_frontier_analysis.diagnostic_frontier: ContinuousC5LiveRunner._frontiers records processed-frame endpoints and is passed only to the R1 diagnostic projection; it is not the U13 R2 coverage admission source.
source_frontier_analysis.architecture_note_for_review: The pinned C5/VAD capture-span type has no mixed real/synthetic sub-frame representation, so semantic capture/content ranges retain the existing frame-quantized endpoint. This can conservatively enlarge the span that U13 evidence would need to cover; it cannot establish coverage because padding emits no native evidence. Changing that product/archive contract is outside U14 and was intentionally not attempted.

reuse_basis: All three current-policy attempts have frame-aligned real input, zero final-frame padding and zero dropped tail, so they never entered the changed residual branch. Existing in-speech synthetic hangover remains covered by the unchanged path. ES2002b attempt 1 remains invalid and cannot be repaired post hoc; EN2009d remains unstarted.
